split_rule: per digit: train pool shuffled with RNG(DERIVE_SUBSEED(seed, 'data:train:<digit>')); train = first 1000, validation = next 100 (disjoint, same train pool); official test = first 200 of the test pool shuffled with RNG(DERIVE_SUBSEED(seed, 'data:test:<digit>'))
nested_k_rule: reuse same class-specific indices for every K containing that class
